correctness.rationale: For each fixed q>=2 and t real, the marker-return alphabet and Kac–Abramov formula turn the variational problem into an entropy relative-entropy inequality. Its unique equality case is a normalized i.i.d. renewal suspension with finite mean, and all no-marker measures have free energy at most log q, proving the pressure root and unique equilibrium. The exact dyadic renormalization F_n converges uniformly on compact u, strict monotonicity yields a uniform moving-phase inverse, and the explicit nonzero Gamma Fourier coefficient rigorously proves the profile is not constant. All quantifiers and the little-oh domain are fixed in RESULT.md. The executed checker tests only finite consequences.

value.rationale: The dyadic length schedule is a natural canonical example of superlinear interspersion. The theorem explains, quantitatively, how marker-using equilibrium measures dominate the full-shift boundary for every finite marker penalty although their pressure advantage is smaller than every ordinary exponential in the penalty fugacity. The exact universal nonconstant phase factor resolves the discrete-scale effect invisible in the coarse entropy root. It is an infinite-family natural thermodynamic classification rather than a routine parameter substitution or an arbitrary finite computation.
